reuse.why: Extends getDateWithSkippedWeekend with holidays and adds a shared isWeekendOrHoliday, but getDatesInRange copies getUpcomingDates' schedule setup and adjustment instead of sharing one occurrence-adjustment function.

duplication.why: The daily skip-vs-move rule and the 7*(holidays+1) lookahead heuristic appear in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange, and schedule-template recomputes the daily/move flag itself.

placement.why: Holiday detection and moving live in shared/schedules, but the daily-skip filtering for listings is inlined in the server handlers and the budget template.

scope.why: Focused on schedule date logic, types, tests and release notes; the rule-utils pass-through of frequency/holidays is required.

maintainability.why: Each further rule change has to be repeated in three listing paths plus a caller-computed noSkipWeekend flag, and the lookahead magic numbers are copied rather than named once.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates/getDatesInRange and budget/schedule-template.ts decide the daily-skip rule themselves rather than through getNextDate or one shared adjustment helper

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange re-expresses getUpcomingDates' filter+map (as forEach with early return and range filter); getNextDate's daily branch repeats the same filter with its own take heuristic

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains holidays; getNextDate gains a daily-frequency special branch; getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template createScheduleList re-implement the daily rule around the helpers
